Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 22 Dulwich Hill Station South Precinct 22.pdf

Clause 9.22.1 - heritage (heritage): The precinct contains part of the South  Dulwich Hill Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.22.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified values of the South Dulwich Hill Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.22.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exists within the precinct.
